bigboy.legs: six short thick piston legs on toothed splayed feet
bigboy.name: Big Boy
bigboy.note: A walking fortress for an Ace Combat style set piece: a 30 m lens-shelled crab that carries a giant boxy siege cannon forward and a missile battery angled up. Its weak points are named for lock-on: the violet core on its back, the two glowing tanks behind it, the core under its belly and the cannon's breech.
bigboy.style: Mining Mike boss kit (tank_bosses_kit.js at 3336b88), alien glows

skitter.legs: four tall arched legs, big joint hubs, hydraulic rods
skitter.name: Skitter
skitter.note: Light and quick: it runs sideways in packs, hosing a mech with the two SMGs it carries where a crab has claws, then looses its two pods of four missiles and is gone again. One big eye in the pale face plate and one in the turret; the long thin legs break first.
skitter.style: Mining Mike boss kit (tank_bosses_kit.js at 3336b88), alien glows
skitter.weapons: twin SMG arms, twin four-tube missile pods, twin turret guns

snapper.legs: six short folded legs on box feet
snapper.name: Snapper
snapper.note: The invaders' line machine, the human mechs' size: a flat armoured hull on six stubby legs and a square face with twin headlight eyes over a grille. It carries its two arms high: a heavy cannon with a reactor core and cooling rings, and a long sword with a glowing edge for when it closes in.
snapper.style: Mining Mike boss kit (tank_bosses_kit.js at 3336b88), alien glows
